News By AutoClaw Team Oct 30 2026 From October 31 to November 8 , log in to AutoClaw and get 40 million Tokens ! A little Halloween treat from AutoClaw! This week's rewards are arriving early, giving you a head start on claiming your credits. Starting October 31 (UTC+8), you can claim a new 40M Tokens (4,000 credits) reward. If you haven't claimed last week's reward yet, you can claim both rewards for up to 80M Tokens (8,000 credits) in total! Event period: October 31, 00:00 – November 8, 23:59 (UTC+8) How it works: Log in to AutoClaw during the event to claim 4,000 credits for this week's campaign — one claim per account. These credits expire on November 8 at 23:59 (UTC+8). Use Your Credits Before They Expire: If you still have unused credits from this week's reward, put them to work on your tasks before they expire on November 1 at 23:59 (UTC+8) . For details, check out last week's event announcement. 🎃 Don't miss this Halloween surprise! Log in to AutoClaw starting October 31 (UTC+8) and make the most of your rewards!
